title: 航空宇宙基礎数学
subtitle: Basic Mathematics for Aerospace Engineering
teachers:
YOSHIDA Keishiro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn basic mathematics knowledge necessary for studying major subjects in Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics. In addition, students will use their knowledge of mathematics to deal with the dynamics of mass points, and acquire the basic skills for examining various engineering problems using mathematics.
advice:
In this course, students will learn the basic mathematics knowledge necessary for studying major subjects in Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics. Contents are as follows:

1 Differential and integral calculus
2 Differential equations
3 Equations of motion
4 Falling motions
    Free-fall motion
    Falling motion with drag which is proportional to the falling velocity
5 Vibration motions
    Response to initial excitation without damping
books: Although a textbook has been specified, the classes will primarily be conducted using handouts.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge on differential/integral calculus and trigometric functions at the high school graduation level.

activityGoals.body: Be able to find derivatives of basic functions
Be able to find indefinite integrals of basic functions
Be able to solve first-order linear differential equations
Be able to solve second-order linear differential equations
Be able to derive the equation of motion for the response to initial excitation without damping

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, students will learn the basic mathematics knowledge necessary for studying major subjects in Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics. Contents are as follows:

1 Differential and integral calculus
2 Differential equations
3 Equations of motion
4 Falling motions
    Free-fall motion
    Falling motion with drag which is proportional to the falling velocity
5 Vibration motions
    Response to initial excitation without damping
